description: FORK: six rounds, one neighbourhood, two futures. Minecraft Java hackathon project.

releases.notes:
This candidate repairs missing inhabitants at camera startup and repeated shot geometry. `/camera film take` now prepares a LIVE session when needed, waits for all three inhabitants and fresh server readiness, then counts down before playing 13 distinct routes once for 90 seconds. Pausing aborts the take; temporary performance settings are restored afterward.

Download `fork-candidate-rc6.zip` for the installer, mod, Singapore district world, matched camera configuration and instructions. Use Minecraft 26.1.2 with the included dependency instructions. Close Minecraft before installing. Existing users need both the new JAR and `camera-paths-product-repair.json`, installed as `config/arenaagents/camera-paths.json`.

Start OBS recording before running `/camera film take`; `/camera film stop` cancels it. This command controls Minecraft's camera, not OBS. The 90-second take excludes its preparation/countdown. Without a completed A/B comparison, comparison slots show scenic product footage and do not invent results.

Verified: build and entrypoints, command routing, capture lifecycle tests, independent camera collision/sightline checks, a fresh headless world spawning all three named inhabitants with safe return, and all 66 package checksums. Actual Laptop playback and a new recording remain pending acceptance. The previous take had severe OBS dropped frames; final film is not attached yet. The hackathon's 15:30 deadline has passed; this is the subsequent repair.

The included map covers approximately one kilometre square of Singapore's CBD around Market Street, Cecil Street, Raffles Place and Telok Ayer. Real map footprints and available heights use one block per metre; facades are approximations and the scenario buildings are fictional. This is not a completed reconstruction of all Singapore. Deterministic scenario/rewind checks passed; three real provider-driven rounds succeeded, but full live A/B completion remains unverified.

FORK: your own fork of Singapore.

Explore a mapped Singapore CBD district, build outside its protected scenario, and meet a medic, engineer and courier. Allocate limited power, play six rounds, rewind and compare possible futures.

Download `fork-candidate-rc5.zip` for the mod, required Fabric API and Carpet dependencies, clean district world, camera presets and installer. The standalone JAR and checksums are also attached. Use Minecraft Java 26.1.2, Fabric Loader 0.19.3 and Java 25. Install into a dedicated compatible instance with the included `Install-Fork.ps1`. Optional `Install-Graphics.ps1` supplies the tested Sodium, Iris and MakeUp Ultra Fast combination.

Open **FORK - Singapore District**. `/fork start live` starts the scenario; `/fork return` brings you to its controls. Press G for the interface. `/fork explore` enables Creative flight and a safe building palette outside the court. `/fork return` restores scenario controls. City edits outside the court persist through scenario rewind.

For a fixed product-showcase recording, start OBS and run `/camera film take`. It plays 13 ordered shots over 90 unpaused presentation seconds, with no looping shots, model requests or waits. Stop OBS at completion; trim only the recording lead-in and tail. `/camera film stop` cancels. `/camera film prepare` separately prepares real Live comparison states. Without completed prepared states, the take warns and uses scenic footage; it does not invent comparison results.

Live mode uses your own supported Codex sign-in and runtime access. The package contains no credentials or Minecraft account data. Explicitly labelled Fixture mode provides deterministic testing.

Verified: client/build entrypoints, camera timing and routing, the exact 90-second timeline, package hashes and 47 earlier runtime checks covering building permissions, both Fixture branches and restoration. Three actual Live rounds with three role responses committed on Laptop. A fourth request hit its 20-second provider deadline; a complete Live A/B run remains unverified. The product showcase is not presented as proof of a full Live A/B run.

The current world covers 1023 by 1023 blocks around Market Street, Raffles Place and Telok Ayer, using OpenStreetMap geometry at one block per metre. Facades are approximate. The clinic and workshop are fictional scenario additions. Whole-island reconstruction is a separate ongoing project; this release does not contain a complete 1:1 Singapore.

Map data: OpenStreetMap contributors. Separate island outline: Natural Earth. New FORK development uses Astra; the reused Agent Arena foundation and its licence remain credited. Minecraft Java Edition is required. This unofficial project is not approved by Mojang or Microsoft.
